title: Can I BEAT Bughouse? (feat. Will Taylor Chess)
summary: The creator plays online Bughouse as a two-player team with YouTuber Will Taylor Chess (on voice chat) against human teams (e.g. a 1200/1300 team), aiming for three wins. Two boards are played simultaneously; pieces you capture go to your teammate's reserve, and they can drop them onto their board instead of moving. The teammates coordinate sacrifices (e.g. on f7/f2) and request pieces; games are often decided on time or by drop mates.
rules: Two boards, two teams of two; teammates play opposite colours on the two boards.
When you capture a piece it is passed to your teammate, who can drop it (in their colour) onto any empty square on their board as their move.
Pawns cannot be dropped on the 1st/8th rank (standard bughouse; inferred). Drops can give check/checkmate.
A team wins when either board ends in checkmate (or a flag/time loss).
win_condition: Checkmate (or flag) on either board wins for the team. Goal: 3 team wins.
